subject: general
question: The Chief Minister of which of the following states launched the common credit portal - Simplified Application for Agricultural Loans (SAFAL) to increase farmers' access to loans'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chief Minister of Odisha, Naveen Patnaik**, launched the common credit portal - **Simplified Application for Agricultural Loans (SAFAL)** on **June 17, 2021.**
 
• The SAFAL portal aims to increase** farmers' access to credit and loans **by providing a simplified application process.
 
• The portal will also enable farmers to **track their loan applications **and receive timely updates on their status.
 
• The SAFAL portal is a joint initiative of the **Odisha State Cooperative Bank (OSCB) **and the** Directorate of Agriculture and Food Production.**
 
• The launch of the SAFAL portal is expected to benefit around** 7 lakh farmers** in Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra:**

 
 
• The state government of Maharashtra has launched **several initiatives** to support farmers, including** loan waiver schemes** and the **Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Farmer Loan Waiver Scheme.**
 
 
 
• **West Bengal**: 
 
 
• The state government of West Bengal has launched several schemes to support farmers, including the **Krishak Bandhu scheme and the Rupashree Prakalpa scheme. **
 
 
 
• **Bihar**: 
 
 
• The state government of Bihar has launched several schemes to support farmers, including the **Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahayata Yojana and the Bihar Kisan Credit Card scheme.**
